claims.assertion: Mari Swa describes Sadicleya as a purpose-built Toleka-class Mark 2 yacht, 30% larger than Mark 1, with two indoor park decks containing a lake, beach, and model Taygetan and human towns under simulated climates.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She describes these as leisure environments and a human-settlement training space.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Mark 2 adds improved pneumatic doors and shipwide wireless electricity and moves the main water tanks below after earlier leaks in Ritol and Toleka.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She presents these as upgrades over Mark 1.

review_flags: The source is a first-person description of unverified spacecraft design.
coverage_gaps: The account also compares Toleka's conversion into a queen's yacht and describes the indoor agricultural and solarium spaces.
